outcome: mode of delivery (cesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: Primigravida women who delivered at a tertiary care hospital in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India from May 2022 to December 2022.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) was associated with adverse maternal and fetal outcomes including preterm delivery, preeclampsia, urinary tract infections, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: 49% of women with GDM had a lower segment cesarean section and 3% had an instrumental delivery.
gest_age: Maximum occurrence of GDM between 34 and 36 weeks of gestation.
birth_weight: 10% of babies born to mothers with GDM were low birth weight.
